astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Vaporizing Meteor Photobombs the Lacerta Nebula
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: What's happening to this meteor? This bright meteor streak appeared and disappeared quickly during a long exposure of the Great Lacerta Nebula, seen faintly in red toward the center of the image.
